name: quicklinks
title: Quicklinks
description: Your own links, opened with Enter, with a {query} slot for search URLs that you fill in from the search bar. Create and edit them in the panel, start from a library of ready-made searches, and import or export them as JSON.
author: pal

settings.label: Import file
settings.description: A JSON array of {name, url, keywords?} listed alongside your own links, read-only; empty for none.

settings.label: Prefer an open tab
settings.text: Open a link by switching to a browser tab already on that page, when there is one
settings.description: Asks the browsers (as Browser Tabs does) before opening; a new tab when none has the page.

store.tagline: Your own links, with a slot for search terms
features: `enter` opens a link; a url with `{query}` asks for the term right in the search bar
`{selection}`, `{clipboard}` and `{files}` fill in by themselves, so one `enter` translates the selected text
Create a link from the tab in front, pick the browser it opens in, edit with `cmd+e`
A library of 25 ready-made searches (Google, Wikipedia, GitHub, npm, MDN, Maps and more)
Optionally switch to a tab that already has the page open instead of opening another
Import and export as JSON; Raycast's quicklinks export is read as is

screenshots.caption: Your links by name: a search link carries its {query} as a tag, one pinned to a browser names it
A search link asks for its query; Enter opens github.com/search with it filled in
Open, Copy URL, Edit, Delete on one of your links
Create Quicklink: name, url with {query}, keywords, the browser to open with
The library: 25 ready-made searches, the ones you have tagged added; Enter adds one to your links
